title: Aromatic Authentic Venezuelan Beef Empanadas
description: Umami and juicy Venezuelan empanadas with a twist of unsweetened cocoa, featuring score-fat and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a quick snack or meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Once the beef is browned, add the onion, garlic, cumin, and paprika to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the unsweetened cocoa powder and cook for an additional minute.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Use a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out circles of dough.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg and fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges together to seal the empanada and use a fork to crimp the edges.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with the remaining egg wash.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
